title: Float label
summary: A real label that moves above a populated or focused native input.
overview: A compact floating-label treatment that keeps label and input semantics native.

component.useWhen: Use float label when its native semantic contract matches the task.
component.avoidWhen: Avoid float label when another native control or navigation pattern communicates the task more clearly.

source.html: Shown to collaborators.
source.css: .c-float-label-demo{--float-label-accent:#b9f474;--float-label-accent-text:#162600;--float-label-border:#dcddd4;--float-label-border-strong:#bfc1b7;--float-label-canvas:#f5f5ef;--float-label-focus:#b9f474;--float-label-font:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;--float-label-muted:#62665d;--float-label-radius:.55rem;--float-label-surface:#fff;--float-label-text:#171915;align-content:center;background:var(--float-label-canvas);display:grid;font-family:var(--float-label-font);min-height:100%;padding:2rem}.c-float-label{display:grid;gap:.5rem;inline-size:min(100%,28rem);margin:auto;position:relative}.c-float-label input{background:var(--float-label-surface);border:1px solid var(--float-label-border-strong);border-radius:var(--float-label-radius);color:var(--float-label-text);font:inherit;min-height:2.75rem;padding:1.1rem .75rem .45rem;width:100%}.c-float-label label{color:var(--float-label-muted);inset:.85rem .75rem auto;pointer-events:none;position:absolute;transition:transform 160ms ease,background 160ms ease}.c-float-label input:focus+label,.c-float-label input:not(:placeholder-shown)+label{background:var(--float-label-surface);color:var(--float-label-text);padding-inline:.2rem;transform:translateY(-1.2rem) scale(.8)}.c-float-label input:focus-visible{outline:.2rem solid var(--float-label-focus);outline-offset:.15rem}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.c-float-label label{transition:none}}

title: Textarea
summary: A labeled native multiline input with helper text and a synchronized character count.
overview: A native textarea recipe that preserves browser editing, selection, spellcheck, and form behavior.

component.avoidWhen: Avoid textarea when another native control or navigation pattern communicates the task more clearly.

examples.title: Basic textarea
examples.description: A complete textarea that is independently copyable in the isolated preview.

source.html: Include the page and action.0 / 240
source.javascript: export function createTextarea(root){const area=root.querySelector('textarea[maxlength]');const count=root.querySelector('[data-textarea-count]');if(!(area instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement)||!(count instanceof HTMLElement))throw new Error('Textarea markup is incomplete.');const update=()=>count.textContent=`${area.value.length} / ${area.maxLength}`;area.addEventListener('input',update);update();return{destroy(){area.removeEventListener('input',update);}}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-component="textarea"]').forEach(createTextarea);

title: Slider
summary: A native range control with a visible synchronized value and bounded steps.
overview: A native range input keeps keyboard increments, form behavior, and assistive technology support platform-owned.

component.avoidWhen: Avoid slider when another native control or navigation pattern communicates the task more clearly.

examples.description: A complete slider that is independently copyable in the isolated preview.

source.html: 65%
source.javascript: export function createSlider(root){const input=root.querySelector('input[type="range"]');const output=root.querySelector('output');if(!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement)||!(output instanceof HTMLOutputElement))throw new Error('Slider markup is incomplete.');const update=()=>{output.textContent=`${input.value}%`;output.value=input.value};input.addEventListener('input',update);update();return{destroy(){input.removeEventListener('input',update);}}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-component="slider"]').forEach(createSlider);

title: Toggle button
summary: A native button with aria-pressed for a reversible command-like on/off state.
overview: A button toggle is distinct from a switch: it represents a reversible command such as pinning or bookmarking.

component.useWhen: Use toggle button when its native semantic contract matches the task.
component.avoidWhen: Avoid toggle button when another native control or navigation pattern communicates the task more clearly.

examples.title: Basic toggle button
examples.description: A complete toggle button that is independently copyable in the isolated preview.

source.html: Pin to dashboard is off.
source.javascript: export function createToggleButton(root){const button=root.querySelector('[aria-pressed]');const status=root.querySelector('[data-toggle-status]');if(!(button instanceof HTMLButtonElement)||!(status instanceof HTMLElement))throw new Error('Toggle button markup is incomplete.');const toggle=()=>{const pressed=button.getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(pressed));status.textContent=`Pin to dashboard is ${pressed?'on':'off'}.`;};button.addEventListener('click',toggle);return{destroy(){button.removeEventListener('click',toggle);}}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-component="toggle-button"]').forEach(createToggleButton);
